title: Programmer productivity and performance on AMD's AI Engines: Offloading Fortran intrinsics via MLIR a case-study
problem: Specialized architectures (FPGAs, AI Engines) offer energy efficiency but require substantial expertise to program; programmers prefer familiar languages like Fortran
motivation: Energy efficiency critical; specialized hardware promising but hard to use; automatic offloading of familiar language constructs could bridge productivity gap
method: MLIR-based Fortran intrinsic offloading to AMD AIE; lower MLIR linear algebra dialect to AIE dialects; demonstrate for Fortran intrinsics on Ryzen AI CPU; no code modifications required
key_novelty: MLIR-based automatic offloading of Fortran intrinsics to specialized hardware (AMD AIEs); compiler-level productivity/performance bridge
contributions: MLIR linear algebra dialect lowering to AIE dialects
Automatic Fortran intrinsic offloading to AIEs
Demonstration on AMD Ryzen AI CPU
Significant performance improvements without code modification
limitations: Evaluation limited to Fortran intrinsics; applicability to full applications unclear
